q1.q: How much does it cost to launch a casino?
q1.a: The Starter Package is $15,000 USD. It includes your selected casino design, online casino slots, casino game tables and your casino branding (logo, colors and domain setup).

q2.q: What is included in the Starter Package?
q2.a: Your selected casino design, online casino slots, casino game tables (e.g. Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat) and your casino branding: logo, colors and domain setup.

q3.a: Live Dealer Tables, Sportsbook, Poker Platform and Sweepstakes. They are optional and quoted separately, so message us with the ones you want.

q4.q: How do I reserve a casino?
q4.a: Choose a design and message us on WhatsApp. A $1,000 hold reserves your casino, then we set it up, brand it and get you live.

q5.q: Can I see a design before I choose?
q5.a: Yes. Tap "View Demo" on any design and we will send you its live demo on WhatsApp.

q6.q: Will the casino carry my own brand?
q6.a: Yes. It launches with your name, logo, colors and your own domain.
